title: Danger-level heat index felt in 13 areas
summary: Thirteen areas experienced danger-level heat index yesterday, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.

blocks.text: Pedestrians use different things like umbrellas and small electric fans to cope with the intense heat while crossing the street in Cubao, Quezon City on April 25, 2024.
MANILA, Philippines — Thirteen areas experienced danger-level heat index yesterday, according to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration.
Masbate City, Borongan in Eastern Samar and Zamboanga City recorded 44 degrees Celsius.
Puerto Princesa City and Cuyo in Palawan recorded 43 degrees Celsius.

Areas that reported 42 degrees Celsius are Mulanay, Quezon; Coron, Palawan; Pili, Camarines Sur; Roxas City, Capiz; Iloilo City and Dumangas in Iloilo; La Granja in La Carlota City, Negros Occidental and Catarman, Northern Samar.
A danger-level heat index ranges from 42 to 51 degrees Celsius.
State meteorologists advised the public to drink plenty of water, avoid going outside between 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. and use sunscreen.
Meanwhile, cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms will be felt in Isabela and Aurora due to the easterlies.
